ios.desc:
Memorila – Learn Words. Remember More.

Memorila is a language learning app designed to help you turn new words into long-term memory. Learn at your own pace, review words at the right time, and watch your vocabulary grow.

KEY FEATURES
- Spaced Repetition: Remember words for longer with a review system designed to strengthen your memory.
- Add new words and phrases manually or use ready-made dictionaries to start learning quickly.
- Three Learning Methods: Choose how you test yourself: multiple-choice answers, recalling the translation, or recalling the original word.
- Listen to natural word pronunciations with AI-powered voice technology.
- Walking Mode: Review words on the go. Memorila reads questions aloud so you can learn while walking or traveling.
- Understand the meaning and differences between similar words and expressions.
- Follow your learning history and watch your vocabulary grow.
- Memorila National Park: Turn your learning progress into a journey through our shared park and see how other learners are progressing.

LEARN AT YOUR OWN PACE
Memorila is made for people who want to do more than recognize new words. It helps you remember vocabulary and use it in real life.
Learn languages, grow your vocabulary, and make learning a part of your everyday routine.
